title: Invariant Entry
description: One system-level behavioral invariant entry stored in docs/INVARIANTS.json. Each entry declares a durable cross-cutting behavioral constraint, its severity, provenance, and optional fixture shape for automated test generation.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Format: inv_NNN with zero-padded 3-digit sequential number. Once assigned, never reused — rename = new ID + deprecate old.

description.description: One-sentence system-level behavioral truth this invariant asserts. Phrased in domain terms (not code terms).

tags.description: Controlled tag set from docs/llm/TAGS.txt. At least one tag required. Used for auto-classification and invariant-to-task fuzzy matching in /z-test Phase 1.

failure_class.description: One-line description of the real-world bug this invariant prevents. Phrased in domain terms (e.g. 'Silent fee drop — feed processes but fee field is zeroed or absent'), not code terms (e.g. 'Null pointer dereference'). Every TESTS.md assertion names this failure class.

fixture_schema.description: OPTIONAL. JSON Schema describing the shape of test fixture data. When present, must include at least one non-trivial constraint (minItems, minimum, not: {const: 0}, etc.) that prevents trivial pass-through. Absent for pure behavioral invariants that don't require fixture data.

fixture_defaults.description: OPTIONAL. Default fixture values used when TESTS.md doesn't specify them. Only valid when fixture_schema is present. Must satisfy fixture_schema. Provides fallback test values so invariants are testable even before fixture authoring.

severity.description: Severity tier. blocker = PR gate fail (must not land with violation). major = PR gate warn (strongly discouraged). minor = informational (logged, not blocking).

source_files.description: Paths to source code files this invariant derives from or applies to, relative to repo root. Used for staleness detection (max mtime vs last_updated) and for invariant-to-plan matching during /z-init-docs --invariants discovery.

last_updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last modification. Compared to source_files max mtime by /z-maintain-docs for staleness detection, and re-checked by /z-test at draft time.

source.description: Provenance of this invariant. spec = mined from SPEC.md invariant lines. plan = derived from PLAN.md design decisions. user-concern = explicitly stated by user. code-review = surfaced by reviewer. axiom-derived = extracted from an axiom record.
